$comment: P42 lane W — TWO accept-direction conformance fixes sharing one witness, because both are ONE conversion composed with an ALREADY-admitted one and both were refused at a site whose sibling site already agreed. (1) D-CSUBSET-LEADING-ATTRIBUTE-BEFORE-TYPEDEF-IS-A-PARSE-ERROR: an attribute BEFORE the `typedef` keyword was a parse error while the MID and TRAILING spellings parsed — MEASURED at 301e2a63 with the shipped CLI, error[P0009] at file scope and error[P0001] at block scope (two codes, two rules). Fixed in `c.lang.json` by giving `typedefDeclSpecifiers` a leading attribute run and marking `topLevel` / `statement` / `extensionTopLevel`'s inner alt `speculative: true` — the resolution `detectAmbiguousAlternatives`'s own refusal text prescribes, taken only after the restructuring alternative was measured and rejected (it would move the leading attribute out of `topLevelDecl`'s `declSpecifiers`, which is exactly the subtree `specifierPrefixChild` hands the linkage scan, so `__attribute__((weak)) int gv;` would parse and SILENTLY LOSE its weak binding). The leading run rides the SAME specifier prefix as the post-keyword run, so the attribute is HONOURED, not parse-and-ignored — pinned separately by test_semantic_analyzer_c's LeadingAttributeBeforeTypedefParsesAndHonoursTheAttribute, which counts four S_DeprecatedSymbolUsed warnings. (2) D-CSUBSET-EXPLICIT-BOOL-CAST-OF-A-FUNCTION-DESIGNATOR: `(_Bool)fn` was error[S0010] while `if (fn)` on the SAME designator compiled and ran; C 6.3.2.1p4 decays the designator in a cast exactly as in a condition, and the HIR side needed NO change because `combineCast`'s `_Bool` arm already defers to `coerceCondition`, whose FnSig arm is what makes `if (fn)` work. REFERENCE CONTROL, each probed SEPARATELY on this very file: gcc 13.3.0 `-std=c2x -Wall -Wextra` and clang 18.1.3 `-std=c23 -Wall -Wextra` both compile it and both EXIT 42 (gcc adds -Waddress on the designator row — a warning about the always-true ANSWER, not about legality). The `plain*` rows are the CONTROL for the speculative dispatch: `typedef`, `__extension__`, `static`, `struct` and a stray `;` each keep a unique 1-token FIRST and must still take the unique-production direct descent. Truth rows are chosen so a wrong answer changes the EXIT: a designator reading FALSE drops 3 (39), a null fn-ptr reading TRUE adds 100 (142). RED-ON-DISABLE (1): drop the leading `{repeat}` from `typedefDeclSpecifiers` -> the five attributed typedefs stop parsing and this example does not compile. RED-ON-DISABLE (2): narrow `isExplicitCastable`'s FnSig arm back to `tk == TypeKind::Ptr` -> `(_Bool)fn` fires S_InvalidCast and this example does not compile.
